exposure: Post exposure prophylaxis (PEP) with hepatitis B vaccine (HBVac) and HBV immunoglobulins (HBIG)
cohort: Infants born to HBsAg positive mothers who received post-exposure prophylaxis at a tertiary care center.
finding: Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) achieved 100% efficacy in preventing HBV transmission among compliant infants at 7 months of follow-up.
